items.title: Corning (GLW) Stock Looks Undervalued As Its 452% Run Tests Fair Value
items.summary: Corning has been on a powerful multi year run, and after a mix of AI focused partnerships and a recent equity offering, the real question is how firmly its current share price rests on the cash flows the business can generate over time. With the stock now in a very different place than it was a few years ago, investors are increasingly asking whether the recent price action still lines up with what the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) view of intrinsic value supports. items.title: AI Trade Picks Up Again as Investors Pile Back Into Stocks
items.summary: The artificial-intelligence rally looked set to restart on Friday, as a drop in bond yields gave risk assets a boost. Glassmaker Corning, optical networking companies Coherent and Lumentum, server maker Dell, and flash-memory product supplier Sandisk were all rallying ahead of the opening bell.
